resources.string: The backup file is too large
Android\'s storage service blocked reading this file. Pick it from Downloads instead of the phone\'s storage folders, or open it with ARK-Launcher from another file manager app.
The file did not open in time. Try again, or pick it from Downloads or another file manager app.
Your current home screen and settings will be replaced. Widgets are restored as tap-to-set-up placeholders.
This also deletes every other profile: %1$s.
It also deletes home screens that are no longer in the list of profiles.
Your profiles changed while the backup was being read, so nothing was restored. Import the file again to see what it would replace.
